title: FunSearch produces a cap set of size 512 in dimension 8 and improves the asymptotic cap set lower bound
summary: FunSearch produced a size-512 cap set in dimension 8 and new asymptotic bounds, published in Nature with independent commentary.
account: On 14 December 2023 Nature published a paper by Google DeepMind researchers with mathematician Jordan Ellenberg (University of Wisconsin–Madison) describing FunSearch, which pairs a pretrained large language model that proposes programs with an automated evaluator that scores them, in an island-based evolutionary loop. Applied to the cap set problem, FunSearch produced a program generating a cap set of size 512 in dimension 8, exceeding the previous best known construction of 496, and found admissible sets that raised the asymptotic lower bound from 2.2180 to 2.2202 after Ellenberg exploited a symmetry noticed in the program's output. Independent commentary by Ernest Davis (NYU, 11 January 2024) accepts the constructions as genuine but rates their mathematical importance as moderate; Terence Tao called the approach a promising paradigm.
purpose: Built to search program space for constructions and heuristics in mathematics and computer science; the cap set constructions were that purpose.
system: FunSearch (LLM-guided evolutionary program search with automated evaluator)
deployer: Google DeepMind with Jordan Ellenberg (University of Wisconsin–Madison)
segment: Industrial research laboratory with academic collaborator

ratings.reason: Mathematicians gained an explicit cap set of size 512 in dimension 8 and an improved asymptotic bound; Davis's independent comment judges the results moderately interesting mathematically.

ai_role.statement: FunSearch generated the programs whose outputs are the cap sets and admissible sets; these are explicit finite objects that the evaluator and readers can verify mechanically. The 2.2202 bound depended on a human (Ellenberg) noticing a symmetry in FunSearch's output and refocusing the search, which Davis identifies as the most notable aspect.
